body: Can you try with a newer version? `r66` just got released.

Just tried it with R66 and the problem remains.
http://www.zen226082.zen.co.uk/swvp01.html.

Also with R66 an additional problem:- the demo does not work in Opera/Windows7 or Opera/Android4.1.2 - I just get a blank screen (I do not know how to debug Opera).
Re: the new (secondary) problem with Opera, on Windows7, Dragonfly reports "Uncaught TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'BYTES_PER_ELEMENT' of #<Uint8Array> "  in Three66min.js line 394
Can you try including `three.js` instead of `three.min.js`? The line number where the error is will be more useful.

OK. I have included three.js (r66) instead of three.min.js.
http://www.zen226082.zen.co.uk/swvp01.html.
Secondary problem has disappeared ...(Opera failing to display on Windows7 or Opera/Android4.1.2).
Primary problem persists ...viewport not clipping line on Android (with Firefox, Opera).

I suspect this is a drivers issue. Here's on Android 4.4.2:
![screenshot_2014-02-18-18-44-38](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/97088/2201944/814e56b4-98f7-11e3-87f1-05653bb9f240.png)
![screenshot_2014-02-18-18-46-35](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/97088/2201947/8625a642-98f7-11e3-992d-d981338d63e8.png)
![screenshot_2014-02-18-18-47-03](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/97088/2201948/8bcd4b86-98f7-11e3-895f-3de278370c94.png)
In the meantime, I figured out why the cube wasn't rendering in Chrome/Android... 1813ee467974aa55d1c34e4aa65d2ad9f120811f

On my Android 4.1.2 with Chrome the app selects canvas instead of webgl and then seems to fail on the command renderer.setViewport.  
Guess I will have to wait for Samsung to make Android 4.4 available in UK.

Ah... that's different.

Yes, `CanvasRenderer` doesn't support yet `setViewport`.

<< CanvasRenderer doesn't support yet setViewport.>>...Aha!
So in Android 4.1.2/Chrome I went to chrome://flags/ and enabled "Override software rendering list" and then webgl works.
The cube renders OK without needing to apply the 1813ee4 fix.

Just for the record: 
- CanvasRenderer (r66) `setViewport` is (still?) missing (again?).. 
- in source & build
Same thing. I think this was implemented after r66 got released.

issue.title: multiple viewports for canvasRenderer
